description: Imports MJML markup into an EmailTemplateDocument. Parsing is XML-based with an mj-raw shim (raw content may be non-well-formed HTML), tolerates comments, preserves unknown elements as raw blocks and unknown attributes in ExtraAttributes, and never throws — failures (including a breach of the EmailImportOptions limits) are returned as ImportMessages.

members.name: Import
members.description: Imports the given MJML markup, optionally resolving mj-include references.
